# FormBhar AI System (llms.txt)

> FormBhar is an AI-powered form auto-filling extension and telemetry API platform for Google Forms and web applications.

## System Capabilities
- **Autonomous & Profile Auto-Fill**: Parses complex form schemas (text inputs, radio buttons, checkboxes, dropdowns, scales) and auto-fills answers based on user profile and learned memories.
- **Self-Improvement Memory Engine**: Ephemeral session log capture, pattern consolidation ("Dreaming Pass"), and heuristic confidence gate promotion ($\ge 0.8$).
- **Multi-LLM Integration**: Supports OpenAI (GPT-4o), Google Gemini 1.5 Flash, Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet, and Groq (Llama 3.3 70B).
- **Dynamic AI Telemetry**: Real-time provider health ranking based on response duration and failure counters.

## Public Endpoints
- `GET /`: Platform documentation, status, and JSON-LD structured data.
- `GET /health`: Uptime monitoring endpoint returning platform health status.
- `GET /api/stats`: Public aggregated telemetry statistics (total users, live active users, total forms filled).

## Developer Resources
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/NotArsal/FormBhar
- Backend API Host: https://formbhar-backend-7ir1.onrender.com
- Version: v2.6.0
